meta=None content=[TextContent(type='text', text='📄 模板「01_串联_触点线圈」（完整内容）：

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!--
  基础示例 01：串联 — 常开触点 + 常闭触点 → 输出线圈
  =====================================================
  电路含义：StartBtn(NO) 串联 StopBtn(NC) 串联 → MotorRun 线圈
  即：启动按钮按下 AND 停止按钮未按 → 电机运行

  核心规则（从此模板可学到）：
  1. Access 元素必须在 <Parts> 顶层，绝不嵌套在 Contact/Coil/Part 内
  2. 功率流引脚（in/out）通过 NameCon↔NameCon 连接
  3. 数据引脚（operand）通过 IdentCon↔NameCon 连接
  4. Contact 引脚：in=功率输入, out=功率输出, operand=变量引脚
  5. Coil 引脚：in=功率输入（无 out）, operand=输出变量引脚
-->
<Document>
  <Engineering version="V17" />
  <SW.Blocks.FC ID="0">
    <AttributeList>
      <AutoNumber>true</AutoNumber>
      <HeaderAuthor />
      <HeaderFamily />
      <HeaderName />
      <HeaderVersion>0.1</HeaderVersion>
      <Interface><Sections xmlns="http://www.siemens.com/automation/Openness/SW/Interface/v5">
  <Section Name="Input" />
  <Section Name="Output" />
  <Section Name="InOut" />
  <Section Name="Temp" />
  <Section Name="Constant" />
  <Section Name="Return">
    <Member Name="Ret_Val" Datatype="Void" Accessibility="Public" />
  </Section>
</Sections></Interface>
      <IsIECCheckEnabled>false</IsIECCheckEnabled>
      <MemoryLayout>Optimized</MemoryLayout>
      <Name>串联_触点线圈</Name>
      <ProgrammingLanguage>LAD</ProgrammingLanguage>
      <SetENOAutomatically>false</SetENOAutomatically>
    </AttributeList>
    <ObjectList>
      <!-- 程序段1：StartBtn(NO) 串联 StopBtn(NC) → MotorRun 线圈 -->
      <SW.Blocks.CompileUnit ID="1" CompositionName="CompileUnits">
        <AttributeList>
          <NetworkSource><FlgNet xmlns="http://www.siemens.com/automation/Openness/SW/NetworkSource/FlgNet/v4">
  <Parts>
    <!-- ① 所有变量访问 Access 写在 Parts 顶层，UId 全局唯一 -->
    <Access Scope="GlobalVariable" UId="1">
      <Symbol>
        <Component Name="DB1" />
        <Component Name="StartBtn" />
      </Symbol>
    </Access>
    <Access Scope="GlobalVariable" UId="2">
      <Symbol>
        <Component Name="DB1" />
        <Component Name="StopBtn" />
      </Symbol>
    </Access>
    <Access Scope="GlobalVariable" UId="3">
      <Symbol>
        <Component Name="DB1" />
        <Component Name="MotorRun" />
      </Symbol>
    </Access>
    <!-- ② Contact 和 Coil 是独立 Part，不嵌套 Access -->
    <!-- 常开触点 (NO)：无子元素 -->
    <Part Name="Contact" UId="10" />
    <!-- 常闭触点 (NC)：加 <Negated Name="operand" /> -->
    <Part Name="Contact" UId="11">
      <Negated Name="operand" />
    </Part>
    <!-- 普通输出线圈 (Coil=普通, SCoil=置位, RCoil=复位) -->
    <Part Name="Coil" UId="12" />
  </Parts>
  <Wires>
    <!-- ③ 功率流：左母线 → Contact(10) in 引脚 -->
    <Wire UId="20"><Powerrail /><NameCon UId="10" Name="in" /></Wire>
    <!-- ④ 数据：变量 Access(1)=StartBtn → Contact(10) operand 引脚 -->
    <Wire UId="21"><IdentCon UId="1" /><NameCon UId="10" Name="operand" /></Wire>
    <!-- ⑤ 功率流串联：Contact(10) out → Contact(11) in -->
    <Wire UId="22"><NameCon UId="10" Name="out" /><NameCon UId="11" Name="in" /></Wire>
    <!-- ⑥ 数据：变量 Access(2)=StopBtn → Contact(11) operand -->
    <Wire UId="23"><IdentCon UId="2" /><NameCon UId="11" Name="operand" /></Wire>
    <!-- ⑦ 功率流：Contact(11) out → Coil(12) in -->
    <Wire UId="24"><NameCon UId="11" Name="out" /><NameCon UId="12" Name="in" /></Wire>
    <!-- ⑧ 数据：变量 Access(3)=MotorRun → Coil(12) operand（输出变量） -->
    <Wire UId="25"><IdentCon UId="3" /><NameCon UId="12" Name="operand" /></Wire>
  </Wires>
</FlgNet></NetworkSource>
          <ProgrammingLanguage>LAD</ProgrammingLanguage>
        </AttributeList>
      </SW.Blocks.CompileUnit>
    </ObjectList>
  </SW.Blocks.FC>
</Document>
', annotations=None)] isError=False
